propositions: Direct Jira status transitions fail when the workflow forbids a single-hop path (e.g. open→done when only open→in_progress→done is allowed), causing ticket drift and outbound sync failures.

Replay must reconstruct the actual recorded intermediate hops from append-only *-STATUS.json event files, ordered chronologically, and replay them in Jira-name space without inverting the non-injective LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA map.

Replay resumes from the current Jira status by matching it directly (forward-mapped) against the recorded hop sequence; on multiple matches it anchors to the last occurrence and replays remaining hops.
Replay aborts and falls through to comment-fallback drift if any hop raises RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError/JiraAPIError.

The replay call site is within _update_one_scalar_update, requiring a new local_id parameter threaded from mutation through update_one, with tracker self-resolved via reconciler_repo_root() and config.tracker_dir().
